name: task-app
description: A Things-style personal task manager backed by your Obsidian vault, driven day-to-day by Claude Code (chat or a scheduled session) for capture, Gmail/Calendar/Slack sync, and daily planning.

scripts.widget: npm --prefix desktop run build && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.skill:pack: cd skill && rm -f ../task-app-skill.zip && zip -qr ../task-app-skill.zip task-app && echo 'Wrote task-app-skill.zip — upload it in Claude: Settings → Capabilities → Skills'
